subject: Error message when dropping markers with elevated number of double crossovers

messages.author: d067fbd7b8a8f3fe
messages.subject: Error message when dropping markers with elevated number of double crossovers
parts:
Hi Dr Karl

I'm using Doubled Haploid wheat population with 17 individuals, 5 phenotypes, 706 markers after #checking segregation distortion. I'm receiving an error message and I do not understand what it means.

> TEyieldARL4 <- markernames(TEyieldARL3)[statMark(TEyieldARL3, stat.type ="marker")$marker$dxo>10]
> TEyieldARL4 <- drop.markers(TEyieldARL3, TEyieldARL4)

> Summary (TEyieldARL4)
Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘Summary’ for signature ‘"dh"’

> Summary (TEyieldARL4, crosstype = "dh")
Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘Summary’ for signature ‘"dh"’
 
How can I resolve this error?

Regards
Celesta

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Error message when dropping markers with elevated number of double crossovers
